nodes.label: docs/specs/ README: Technical Specifications (SPECS tier)
nodes.description: Index of the SPECS tier, tier four of the D-29 hierarchy (PRD, Modular_PRD, Fn_Specs, SPECS). Living documents with no build-version prefix that never freeze; V1 tracking files freeze at sprint close but specs are edited by whichever build is active. Path-representation node added for exact source_file coverage under D-246; read the source for content.

nodes.label: SPECS-PUBLICATION: publish path and retry scheduler
nodes.description: SPECS document authorized by D-143 (2026-08-28) ruling Q3 (Supabase Edge Function as the publish path) and Q5 (pg_cron as the retry scheduler). Planning only. Concerns the future automated publication path; V1 LinkedIn ManualReady (D-243) needs no external-channel credential. Path-representation node for D-246 coverage.

nodes.label: docs/v1/ README: V1 sprint tracking index
nodes.description: Index of the V1 tracking files (decision register, build spec, artifact inventory, phase closure). States these are tracking files, not specifications, and that they freeze when V1 closes. Path-representation node for D-246 coverage.

nodes.label: Work packet SETUP-SPIKE-000/S2: line assignment and four-eyes
nodes.description: D-240 MMF checklist for setup sprint S2, HELD under D-171. Under D-244 its Line/RACI display moves to V1-SM05 as display-only, while the security-invoker RPC, T6, blind pass and EmergencyBypass stay held. Not retired, earns no DoD.

nodes.label: Work packet SETUP-SPIKE-000/S3: board, filters, audit log
nodes.description: D-240 checklist for setup sprint S3. Under D-244 board and filter visibility moves to V1-SM06; the T6 to T5 return-rate audit view stays held with T6. Not retired, earns no DoD.

nodes.label: Work packet SETUP-SPIKE-000/S4: publication and fallback
nodes.description: D-240 checklist for setup sprint S4. Under D-243 and D-244 LinkedIn ManualReady moves to V1-SM06, while automated WordPress, retry, privileged credentials and FR-10/T11 live-URL confirmation are a V2-target backlog with no V2 opened. Not retired until every behaviour and citation has moved.

nodes.label: Work packet V1-SM05 (MMF-V1-CORE)
nodes.description: First V1 MMF checklist: a limited Route-1 evidence slice on ROUTE-PROD-1 that records and displays business-stage, role, task and evidence facts and does not claim transition:T* execution (D-249). D-245 defines its DoD (not complete, not reviewed); DoR items DOR-R2 to DOR-R4 have drafted failure and replay contracts awaiting Lane B feasibility review, while DOR-R5 and DOR-R6 remain open. Satisfies CR-19 only partially. Not started and not selected.

nodes.label: Work packet V1-SM06 (MMF-V1-USABLE)
nodes.description: Second V1 MMF checklist: board visibility and the LinkedIn target-level ManualReady event (D-243). Depends on V1-SM05 reaching DoD. Three ManualReady children (trigger, acting authority, revision) stay open; FR-10 is a V2 target. DoD defined by D-245, not complete. Not started and not selected.

nodes.label: D-242: Intent, Build and DevOps governance separated
nodes.description: Separates Intent governance (Lane A with the Judge), backlog refinement (raising lane), Build governance and xDD selection (Lane B) and DevOps/DevSecOps assistance (Lane C), each with one canonical destination. Meaning ownership is not filesystem stewardship. Release is a separate gate. Corrects B-114 by reference.

nodes.label: D-243: V1 publication boundary, LinkedIn ManualReady
nodes.description: Amends D-239: V1-SM06 may append a LinkedIn target-level ManualReady publication event after the business:T5 record; it is not an article state. FR-10/T11 live-URL confirmation and automated WordPress are a V2-target backlog; sections keep [V1] origin, no [V1 to V2] marker. Trigger, acting authority and revision children stay open.

nodes.label: D-244: setup transfer, Choice A (transfer mapped; closure pending)
nodes.description: Maps each unfinished SETUP-SPIKE-000 S2-S4 behaviour to exactly one destination while S0/S1 remain completed evidence. It is a transfer map, not a closure: under D-248 the setup programme stays open while S2-S4 or their residuals are non-terminal. No DoD credit, no terminal disposition, no packet retirement, no blanket V2. Corrects the Modular_PRD publish-path row to D-143/D-146.

nodes.label: D-245: SM05/SM06 readiness contracts and one-MMF PR template
nodes.description: Defines DoD for both MMF packets (defined, not complete, not reviewed) with an evidence-based DoR status, and creates .github/PULL_REQUEST_TEMPLATE/v1-mmf.md, which selects nothing and grants no authority. Merge is not DoD.

nodes.label: D-246: graph coverage-only manifest and exact source-path evidence
nodes.description: Amends D-231: an exact glob-free coverage-only manifest (non-authoritative plan-pack documents and named historical journals) applies to graph-coverage only while docs-drift still sees every path; coverage evidence is a node whose source_file equals the document path; a live citation of a manifest journal fails the check.
